pages.text: After a decade of peace, no notable flowers had joined the Botanist Flora. Then, one day, a space time super nova struck the realm of Botanists!$(br2)The mystical flowers that dominated the overworld surface have been scattered elsewhere. Some of them even transformed into a different form of themselves! Others have $(bold)Evolved/$.
Other anomilies that have resulted from the super nova have been documented in other entries.
